title: Travel Co-ordinator
description:
Job Purpose
To manage end-to-end travel for all employees - domestic and international - including air ticketing,
accommodation, and visa processing across a range of destination countries. The role currently operates on a
direct-booking model (via travel agents/vendors) and is expected to evolve toward administering a self-service
travel booking portal as the travel volume grows; the co-ordinator will play a key role in evaluating and helping
roll that out when the time comes.

Key Accountabilities
1. Air Ticketing & Travel Booking
• Book and manage domestic and international flight tickets for employees directly with travel
agents/airlines, balancing cost, convenience, and travel policy compliance.
• Compare fares/routes across airlines and agents to get the best value for each trip.
• Handle date changes, cancellations, and rebookings quickly, including for last-minute or urgent travel.

2. Visa & Immigration Documentation (Multi-Country)
• Determine the correct visa category and documentation requirements for each destination country an
employee is traveling to - since requirements differ significantly by country and cannot be handled with
a single standard process.
• Prepare and submit visa applications, coordinating directly with embassies, consulates, and visa agencies
to meet travel timelines.
• Maintain a living reference of visa requirements, processing times, and documentation checklists for the
countries employees most frequently travel to, updating it as rules change.
• Track passport expiry and visa validity for frequent travelers, flagging renewals proactively before they
become a travel blocker.

3. Accommodation
• Book hotels for employees and visiting clients or guests, matching location, safety, and budget to the
purpose of the trip.
• Negotiate corporate rates with preferred hotel chains and vendors to reduce cost per trip.

4. Vendor Management & Negotiation
• Own relationships with travel agents, airlines, hotel chains, and visa-processing agencies, including
negotiating rates and contract terms directly.
• Run periodic vendor comparisons to ensure the comoany continues to get competitive pricing as travel
volume grows or destinations shift.
• Escalate and resolve vendor service issues (delayed visas, booking errors, refund disputes).

5. Budget & Reporting
• Track travel spend against budget and flag overruns early.
• Prepare monthly travel expense summaries for the Admin Manager.
• Coordinate with Finance on invoice processing and expense reconciliation.

6. Employee Support & Duty of Care
• Act as the single point of contact for employees before and during their trip for booking changes, delays,
or travel-related issues.
• Maintain a travel tracker with employee itineraries and emergency contact details for anyone traveling
internationally.
• Monitor relevant travel advisories for destination countries and flag any risk proactively to travelers and
the Admin Manager.

Working Relationships
Internal:
• HR - for new joiner relocation and onboarding travel
• Finance - for invoicing, budget tracking, and expense reconciliation
• Employees and function heads across the Company
External:
• Travel agents, airlines, and online booking platforms
• Hotel chains and accommodation vendors
• Visa-processing agencies, embassies, and consulates across multiple countries

Work Experience
• 3–5 years of experience in travel desk/travel coordination, ideally in a corporate environment with
international travel exposure.
• Demonstrated experience handling visa applications for more than one or two countries - comfortable
researching and applying new country-specific requirements, not just following a fixed checklist.
• Some prior experience negotiating rates or terms directly with travel vendors.
• Exposure to a corporate travel booking portal/TMS (even as an end-user)

Qualification
 Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
Skills
• Working knowledge of visa and documentation requirements across multiple countries, or a
demonstrated ability to research and apply them quickly.
• Vendor negotiation and rate comparison skills.
• Proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and comfort learning new booking/software tools.
• Strong organizational skills - able to juggle multiple traveler itineraries and deadlines at once.
• Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable coordinating with employees, vendors, and
consulates directly.
• High attention to detail, particularly around visa documentation where errors can delay travel.
Behavioral Competencies
• Calm and solution-oriented under time pressure, especially for last-minute or urgent travel changes.
• Ownership mindset - follows through on a booking or visa case until it's actually resolved, not just
logged.
• Discretion in handling employees' personal and travel-related data.
• Proactive communicator who flags risks (visa delays, advisory changes) before they become last-minute
problems.

title: Senior Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
About Inito

Inito is building the future of personalised healthcare by combining cutting-edge technology with deep medical expertise. Our flagship product, the Inito Fertility Monitor, is used by customers across the globe to track hormones and better understand their reproductive health. Behind the scenes, we build highly reliable diagnostic systems, intuitive digital experiences, and secure health data infrastructures.

We are a fast-growing, mission-driven team obsessed with accuracy, usability, and impact. At Inito, you'll work on products that directly help people make informed decisions about their health—while solving complex engineering challenges at scale.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Software QA Engineer who will take ownership of quality across our mobile applications and backend services. This role spans REST API testing, mobile app validation (iOS & Android), and automation — ensuring our products meet the highest standards of reliability and usability.
The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience in both app and API testing, can build and maintain automation frameworks, and collaborates effectively with Product and Engineering teams to embed quality throughout the development process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development, product, and business teams to understand software requirements and develop detailed test cases and test plans.
  • Conduct functional, non-functional, smoke, sanity, regression, compatibility, and integration testing across web, iOS, and Android applications and backend services.
  • Perform REST API and server-side testing to validate business logic, data integrity, and system behaviour.
  • Write and execute automation test cases using tools such as Appium, Selenium, or API automation frameworks, ensuring thorough coverage and efficient execution.
  • Take ownership of the automation framework — keeping tests stable, scalable, and reliable across releases.
  • Monitor automation execution in CI/CD pipelines, investigate failures, identify root causes, and track defects through to resolution.
  • Execute test cases, document results, and raise detailed bug reports with reproduction steps and impact analysis using issue tracking tools (e.g. JIRA).
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose software issues, working closely with developers to drive timely resolution.
  • Participate in defect root cause analysis and contribute proposed solutions and process improvements.
  • Validate backend data and understand database relationships to verify API responses and business logic accuracy.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and promote quality best practices across the team.
  • Continuously learn and apply industry-standard testing methodologies, tools, and practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications


  • B.E. / B.Tech. / M.E. / M.Tech. / MCA with 2–4 years of experience in software testing.
  • Proven experience testing Web, iOS, and Android applications.
  • Strong hands-on experience in REST API testing and backend validation.
  • Good knowledge of Postman, including collection management, environments, and scripting.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL and database validation for backend testing.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across Product, Engineering, and QA teams.
  • Familiarity with bug tracking and test management tools (e.g. JIRA, TestRail).
  • High sense of ownership and accountability for product quality.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with API automation frameworks (Newman, Playwright API, or similar).
  • Familiarity with automated testing tools (e.g. Appium, Selenium, TestNG) and experience writing and maintaining automated test cases.
  • Knowledge of performance and load testing tools.
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana, or Datadog
